#  12721 - Advanced Seminar Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **12721**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Advanced Seminar**  |  
|  Oberseminar   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 1 - Mathematics, Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technology   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr. habil. Cunningham, Douglas 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 3 semesters  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  12   |  
| Learning Outcome:  | This module enables students to present and discuss scinetific papers related to their PhD study. The students will further develop their skills and competencies: scientific research and analysis skills, communication skills, problem-solving skills, competencies for concept development and project management.  |  
| Contents:  | This module is concerned with varying contents according to the PhD study of the individual students. The state of the art of the different topic is presented.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 6 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 270 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Bibliography will be presented during the seminar.  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Three presentations, each one 33,3%  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Structural Doctoral Programme / Dependable Systems / PO 2012 

 |  
| Remarks:  | None  |  
| Module Components:  | Advances Seminar Dependable Systems  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
